caption:
A plain sorry takes about six seconds.
In a 2007 paper in Science, researchers describe how people hold some things as sacred. A trade offered for them often fails, while a symbolic gesture, like an apology, can reopen the talk. Source: Atran, Axelrod and Davis 2007, Science, https://doi.org/10.1126/science.1144241
For whoever has a plain sorry to say this week.
